C0372.title: Keycloak Separates Password and OTP Brute-Force Protection to Prevent OTP Bypass Attacks
C0372.summary: In 2024, a security flaw was discovered in the open-source identity management software Keycloak, where an attacker who obtained a user's password could brute-force the OTP verification code, bypassing two-factor authentication.
